426:t_021:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$n! Nobody but you can settle things with Miss $$スズネ$$!」

426:t_021:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「However it turns out, you're the one who decides how it ends!!」

426:t_022:5.en:
$n
「...$$アドヴェント#pilot$$. Until now, I've kept relying on Miss $$スズネ$$ and you...」

426:t_022:6.en:
$n
「But right now, I'm in a place where I have to fight with my own strength!」

426:t_022:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「...Looks like you don't need my help anymore.」

426:t_022:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$n... Let me see you fight.」

426:t_023:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Tch... that pretty boy.」

426:t_025:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Too bad, $$バルビエル$$. $n isn't going the way you wanted.」

426:t_025:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Keep your hands off. I'm the one who hunts $n.」

426:t_025:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Tch... I've gone and awakened a troublesome one.」

426:t_027:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「This $$ジェミニア#robot$$ is loaded with a pseudo-$$スフィア$$... So the situation is the reverse of the $$ジェニオン$$'s back in the $$時獄戦役$$.」

426:t_027:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「While I'm at it. It wouldn't be a $$ジェミニア#robot$$ without these guys around.」

426:t_028:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Those are $$ジェミニス$$ units!」

426:t_028:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「The nuisances are out of the way. Let's have plenty of fun, shall we, $n?」

426:t_028:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「Sorry, but I'm going to get in your way, Miss $$スズネ$$!」

426:t_028:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「I don't know what's going on, but I won't let you do $n in, Teacher!」

426:t_028:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We're going to stop Miss $$スズネ$$!」

426:t_028:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「And we'll have you come back! Back to us!」

426:t_028:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ isn't just your teacher, you know.」

426:t_028:9.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Yeah, yeah! She's the Volunteer Club's madonna, after all!」

426:t_028:11.en:
$$アルト$$
「We're getting Miss $$スズネ$$ back with all of our strength!」

426:t_028:14.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You crack me up, you dunderheads! Then I'll deal with you all at once!」

426:t_028:15.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Stop me if you can! I'm free now!」

426:t_029:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「...That's enough for today. That should do for showing my face.」

426:t_029:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I'll take the $$スフィア$$ you've raised, just as it is. After all, half of the credit for growing the $$いがみ合う双子$$ to this point goes to my power.」

426:t_030:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Damn! $n's mind is at its limit!」

426:t_030:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'll go! $$ランド$$, cover me!」

426:t_031:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「The $$悲しみの乙女$$, huh?」

426:t_031:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$! What are you planning to do!?」

426:t_031:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「But I'm not your opponent.」

426:t_032:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Ruled by your emotions, you were slow to notice me closing in.」

426:t_033:3.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Looks like she passed out. Cute, isn't she?」

426:t_034:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Keep your hands off, $$アムブリエル$$. $$セツコ$$ is mine.」

426:t_034:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I won't let either you or $$アウストラリス$$ lay a hand on her.」

426:t_034:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「A bit of a shame, but I have other prey.」

426:t_034:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「See you, $n. Overcome the backlash by the next time we meet.」

426:t_034:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Get back here, $$バルビエル$$!」

426:t_034:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Where do you think you're taking $$セツコ$$!」

426:t_034:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$セントラル・ベース$$... I'll be waiting for you there.」

426:t_035:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「$$バルビエル$$ and Miss $$スズネ$$ have withdrawn.」

426:t_035:1.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Tracking is impossible... We've lost them completely...」

426:t_035:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We know where they're headed.」

426:t_035:3.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「$$セントラル・ベース$$ in the south of the Central Continent... So that's the last stronghold of the $$サイデリアル$$?」
